entry.name: jit.viddll.record
entry.description: The jit.record object take a sequence of Jitter matrices as input, saving the sequence to disk as a movie file. Currently only 4 plane, char type matrix input is supported.

attributes.name: adapt
attributes.digest: Adapt output matrix dimensions
attributes.description: Adapt output matrix dimensions to matrix input. If dimension arguments provided, default = 0, otherwise default = 1.

attributes.name: cache_size
attributes.digest: The maximum cache size in gigabytes
attributes.description: The maximum cache size in gigabytes (default = 0.). A non-zero cache_size allows for asynchronous writing in a background thread. The attribute sets the size of the cache used to store incoming frames. Frames are dropped when cache size is reached. Notifications are used to alert user when cache is full or when ready for more frames (cache_full, cache_ready). When enabled andis received, the write thread will finish writing cached frames before sending thecomplete notification. Use themessage to discard any frames stored in the cache and close the file immediately. Setting cache_size to 0 disables the async writing.

messages.name: cancel
messages.description: Cancel the recording, discarding any frames stored in the cache, and close the file.

messages.name: dictionary
messages.description: FFmpeg encode options are set by passing a Max dictionary object. Support for each option is unknown. The options dictionary is persistent across writes, so setting it once will affect all subsequent writes.

messages.name: write
messages.digest: Write input to a disk file as a movie file
messages.description: Writes the sequence of incoming Jitter matrices to disk as a movie file. The default is to write a 30. fps h264 codec. See theattribute for list of possible codec values. When theormessage is received, the file is closed and a write notification is sent to the dumpout.
